You settle a storage policy from storage standards, design documents, a platform handbook, Slack threads and Jira comments.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Precedence rule: when sources disagree, the order of authority is storage-standard > design-memo > platform-handbook > slack-thread > jira-comment. Inside one source, the higher version wins.
- [e002] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the encryption mode is `enc-aes-gcm`.
- [e003] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the replication mode is `repl-sync`.
- [e004] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the versioning depth is `10`.
- [e005] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the checksum type is `xxh3-sum`.
- [e006] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the WORM mode is `OFF`.
- [e007] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the max object size in GB is `5`.
- [e008] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the erasure code is `ec-4-2`.
- [e009] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the snapshot tool is `restic-snap`.
- [e010] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the scrub interval in days is `14`.
- [e011] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the dedupe mode is `OFF`.
- [e012] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the quota per bucket in GB is `200`.
- [e013] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the tiering engine is `tier-intelligent`.
- [e014] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the object lock mode is `lock-legal-hold`.
- [e015] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the rebuild throttle in MB per second is `500`.
- [e016] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the backup target is `bkt-oregon`.
- [e017] The platform-handbook document HBK-132 (version 1) states that the compression mode is `OFF`.

Sources, from highest to lowest authority: storage-standard, design-memo, platform-handbook, slack-thread, jira-comment. When two sources disagree, the higher one decides.
Inside one source, a higher version number overrides a lower one. A withdrawn document no longer counts at all.
Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by a document that states it or by the withdrawal of a document. A proposal, a question, a link or a quote of an old page changes nothing.
- The value of a parameter comes from the valid documents that state it. The highest source decides. Inside that source, the document with the higher version decides.
- A new document of a lower source does not replace the value of a higher source.
- A withdrawn document is not valid. The value then comes from the other valid documents by the same rule.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
